verdict: First-ever run of the fr language path (Boule de Suif). Extraction/clustering has two real, verified defects: the comte/comtesse de Bréville household is lost entirely (fr_core_news_lg tags the bare surname PLACE; STU-780), and M. Loiseau is merged into his wife's entity because the household-split logic never sees a second independently-titled candidate to conflict against (STU-781) — both are new edge cases of an already-known bug class, not novel mechanisms. Generation also renders a one-sided, rejected seduction attempt as an unqualified mutual 'romance' infobox slot on both parties (STU-779), exactly the plot-inversion the ground-truth corpus was built to catch. Coverage is 13/13 batch entities with pages, but that count already excludes the two lost Bréville characters — it is not a clean roster. Priority for the next run: fix STU-780 (Bréville) first — it is the only defect that outright deletes named principal characters rather than mis-describing them.
